name: canvas-workbook-open
caption: The Busbetrieb Nord workbook draft after Adjust. Workbook check shows 85 rows to load and 9 refused; the proposed cards have not created a workspace.

name: canvas-workbook-connect
caption: Haltestellen is related to Namen. The notice says no workbook column was found to fill the link; Undo is available.

name: canvas-workbook-columns-as-rows
caption: Perron A, Perron B and Perron C are selected. Read 3 columns as rows into asks which object type or attribute to fill.

name: canvas-workbook-readings
caption: The Perron A menu offers Fill blanks from the cell above, Rows holding only this column are headings…, Make an object type of its values and Leave out.

name: canvas-workbook-navigation
caption: Navigation shows the proposed Haltestellen lists group, entries Not in a group and a New group destination.

name: canvas-workbook-refused
caption: Namen has 9 refused rows because no record matches the reference. See the rows opens their details.

name: canvas-workbook-create-dialog
caption: Create workspace proposes Busbetrieb Nord canvas as the name and reports 85 rows to load and 9 refused rows that stay out. Creation has not been confirmed.

name: canvas-model-whole
caption: Whole model is selected in Guide canvas draft. Network and Systems frame their object types; visible cards are marked Released, and Fit is at the lower right.

name: canvas-model-add-menu
caption: The header’s + menu offers Application…, Object type…, Attribute type…, Relation type… and Navigation group….

name: canvas-model-attribute
caption: FSO number on Canton is a Whole number. Required is off and Unique is on; the inspector also offers Move to… and further operations.

name: canvas-model-relation-rule
caption: Canton contains District is selected. Its popover explains the parent and child types and offers Which records may be chosen and All operations.

name: canvas-model-navigation
caption: Network, Systems and Names each show collections Not in a group and a New group destination.

name: canvas-model-views
caption: Canton has a Geography tree in Network and no view in Names. Preview tables and record page and Edit layout are available.

name: canvas-model-consumer
caption: The Consumer APIs tab lists Stops API, version 1, marked Released, with a + control to add another contract.

name: canvas-model-issues
caption: The draft has one issue: a view refers to a field that does not exist. The link opens the affected Municipalities view in Network.

name: canvas-model-history
caption: History records one whole-model edit by Guide Admin and offers Undo for that step.
